name: Netting
definition: Offset of payables against receivables to reduce credit exposure to a counterparty.

AmountDirection.name: Amount Direction
AmountDirection.definition: Specifies whether the amount is a debit or a credit.

AverageDealPrice.name: Average Deal Price
AverageDealPrice.definition: Average price of the netted trades.

RelatedSecuritiesClearingProcess.name: Related Securities Clearing Process
RelatedSecuritiesClearingProcess.definition: Clearing process which includes the netting.
